from strategy import *
import shutil
def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    c=read(BASE/'metrics/comparison.json');replay=read(BASE/'docs/panic-reverse-portfolio.json')
    assert c['qualified']==['D','F','T'] and replay['both_metrics_beat_v5_both_orders'] and not replay['changed_source_or_t_minus_5_on_panic_dates']
    r=c['by_style']['P'];assert r['own_top3_ties']==0 and r['order_invariant'] and r['candidate']['net_sharpe']>r['v5']['net_sharpe'] and r['candidate']['net_ann']>r['v5']['net_ann']
    out=BASE/'metrics/four-style-comparison.json'
    if not out.exists():
        c['qualified']=STYLES;c['by_style']['P']['passed']=True;c['by_style']['P']['portfolio_reverse_audit']=fingerprint(BASE/'docs/panic-reverse-portfolio.json')
        c['decision_note']='The specified ES test is unchanged best round, and final boundaries were to be audited. An initial implementation also required zero boundaries on all market days, including days outside a specialist’s scoring dates. Retained as the separate v5 panic fallback comparison. Direct replay establishes zero change in P dates or their H5 lag turnover and both metrics win. All four pass the specified own-style test.'
        write(out,c)
        note('P confirmed after full-calendar reverse top3 replay: identical own-style holdings, fees and both model metrics. Run four experts under the original gate; retain D/F/T-only fallback accounts as sensitivity. No model refit.')
    if not (BASE/'docs/route-four-inputs.json').is_file():
        first=read(BASE/'docs/route-inputs.json')
        forecast=read(CAMPAIGN/'classifier/metrics/evaluation.json')['primary_predictions'];check(forecast)
        df=pd.read_csv(ROOT/forecast['path'],usecols=['date','target_date','predicted_label',*['p_'+v for v in STYLES]],parse_dates=['date','target_date'])
        vp=read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['ensemble'];check(vp);v5=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/vp['path']).iloc[:,0]
        pfile=read(BASE/'docs/predictions-P.json')['ensemble'];check(pfile);pp=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/pfile['path']).iloc[:,0];assert pp.index.equals(v5.index) and np.isfinite(pp).all()
        ds=v5.index.get_level_values('datetime');dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds.unique()).sort_values();routes={}
        for parent,base_rec in first['routes'].items():
            key='four_'+parent
            weights=pd.read_csv(ROOT/base_rec['weights_file']['path'],index_col=0,parse_dates=True,float_precision='round_trip')
            conf=df.set_index(base_rec['join_key']).reindex(dates);assert weights.index.equals(dates)
            hard=parent.startswith('hard');pwt=conf.predicted_label.eq('P').astype(float) if hard else conf.p_P.fillna(0.)
            weights['P']=pwt;weights['v5']-=pwt
            assert np.max(abs(weights.v5[conf.predicted_label.notna()]))<1e-12
            weights.loc[conf.predicted_label.notna(),'v5']=0.;assert np.allclose(weights.sum(axis=1),1.)
            oldsig=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/base_rec['prediction']['path']).iloc[:,0];assert oldsig.index.equals(pp.index)
            if hard:
                switch=ds.isin(dates[pwt.eq(1.)]);outvec=oldsig.to_numpy().copy();outvec[switch]=pp.to_numpy()[switch]
            else:
                outvec=oldsig.to_numpy()+pwt.reindex(ds).to_numpy()*(_zscore_by_day(pp).to_numpy()-_zscore_by_day(v5).to_numpy())
            wf=BASE/'data'/f'route-{key}-weights.csv';weights.to_csv(wf)
            sf=BUNDLE/f'route-{key}.pkl';pd.DataFrame({'score':outvec},index=v5.index).to_pickle(sf)
            routes[key]=dict(weights_file=fingerprint(wf),prediction=fingerprint(sf),join_key=base_rec['join_key'],mean_weights=weights.mean().to_dict(),missing_forecast_v5_fallback=base_rec['missing_forecast_v5_fallback'])
        write(BASE/'docs/route-four-inputs.json',dict(**{k:v for k,v in first.items() if k not in ['qualified','sources','routes']},qualified=STYLES,sources={**first['sources'],'P':pfile},routes=routes))
    for key in read(BASE/'docs/route-four-inputs.json')['routes']:
        if not (BASE/'metrics'/f'account-{key}.json').is_file():
            with (BASE/'docs'/f'account-{key}.log').open('a') as f:subprocess.run([sys.executable,__file__,key],cwd=ROOT,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
    if len(sys.argv)>1:
        # The common account runner resolves its signal from a frozen inventory. Supply the four-expert inventory for this isolated call.
        import strategy as engine
        orig=engine.read
        def resolve(p):
            if Path(p)==BASE/'docs/route-inputs.json':p=BASE/'docs/route-four-inputs.json'
            return orig(p)
        engine.read=resolve
        try:engine.account(sys.argv[1])
        except BaseException:
            path=BASE/'docs'/f'account-{sys.argv[1]}-failure-{int(time.time())}.json';write(path,dict(error=traceback.format_exc()));note('Derived four-style account failed '+str(path.relative_to(ROOT)));raise
    else:
        from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import _zscore_by_day
        main()
